title: Casting Industry
description: Specialized ERP solutions for foundries and casting operations, optimizing production from pattern making to finished product delivery.

infoCards.title: Foundry Control
infoCards.description: Complete foundry operations management with real-time monitoring of casting processes and quality parameters.

infoCards.title: Material Flow
infoCards.description: Streamlined management of casting materials, alloys, and consumables with automated tracking and optimization.

faqData.question: How does the system handle quality control?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive quality control tools including process monitoring, inspection checkpoints, and quality metrics tracking throughout the casting process.

faqData.question: Can it manage different casting processes?
faqData.answer: Yes, the solution supports various casting processes including sand casting, investment casting, die casting, and can be customized for specific process requirements.

faqData.question: What kind of material management features are available?
faqData.answer: The system offers complete material tracking, including raw materials, alloys, consumables, and finished products, with automated inventory alerts and material usage optimization.
